h1: Golf Cart Rentals for HITS Ocala
lead: Heading to HITS Post Time Farm for a horse show? Masters Golf Cars rents golf carts to riders, trainers, and fans. We have been doing this for over 26 years.
The Ocala Winter Circuit runs from January to April. It is a big deal in Marion County. Our shop on US-441 in Belleview is just a few miles from HITS. We keep more than 300 golf carts ready to go.

We have over 300 golf carts. Need just one? We got you. Need 20 for your whole barn? We can do that too. Masters Golf Cars has been in business since 1999. We know how to handle big events.
Showing for many weeks? We give better prices for longer rentals. Call early to lock in your rate. The Winter Circuit books up fast.

intro: HITS Post Time Farm sits in Ocala, Florida. It is home to the famous Ocala Winter Circuit. Top hunter/jumper riders from all over come here. The shows run from January through April.
The farm has a Grand Prix ring, warm-up areas, and space for 1,500 horses. Big events like the $1 Million Grand Prix happen here. Riders compete for prize money and points all season.
The grounds spread out. Getting around on foot takes forever. That is why most people rent a golf cart. Masters Golf Cars brings yours right to your barn.

sections.h2: How to Rent Golf Carts for HITS

p: Tell us which weeks you are showing. The Winter Circuit books fast. The sooner you call, the better your chance of getting what you want.
We will give you a price. Plans change? No problem. We can add or drop weeks during the circuit. Just let us know.
Our team brings your golf cart to HITS Post Time Farm. It shows up with gas and ready to go. We drop it at your barn.
When your show weeks end, just call. We come get the cart. Need to stay longer? We can stretch your rental easy.
